ledger = [
    {"id": "REQ-1", "kind": "functional",     "status": "confirmed"},
    {"id": "REQ-2", "kind": "functional",     "status": "draft"},
    {"id": "REQ-3", "kind": "non-functional", "status": "draft"},
    {"id": "REQ-4", "kind": "functional",     "status": "confirmed"},
    {"id": "REQ-5", "kind": "non-functional", "status": "confirmed"},
    {"id": "REQ-6", "kind": "functional",     "status": "draft"},
]

def count(records, kind=None, status=None):
    n = 0
    for r in records:
        if kind is not None and r["kind"] != kind:
            continue
        if status is not None and r["status"] != status:
            continue
        n += 1
    return n

print("total:", count(ledger))
print("functional:", count(ledger, kind="functional"))
print("quality:", count(ledger, kind="non-functional"))
print("drafts:", count(ledger, status="draft"))
print("confirmed quality:", count(ledger, kind="non-functional", status="confirmed"))

tests.code: assert count(ledger, status='draft') == 3, 'expected 3 drafts | got %r' % count(ledger, status='draft')

notes = [
    {"who": "clerk",      "text": "search by phone number",            "tag": "need"},
    {"who": "nurse",      "text": "see today's schedule at a glance",  "tag": "need"},
    {"who": "manager",    "text": "check-in under 15 seconds",         "tag": "goal"},
    {"who": "compliance", "text": "log retained for 7 years",          "tag": "constraint"},
    {"who": "manager",    "text": "zero missed handoffs per shift",    "tag": "goal"},
    {"who": "sponsor",    "text": "budget capped at 20000 USD",        "tag": "constraint"},
    {"who": "clerk",      "text": "flag patients needing interpreter", "tag": "need"},
]

def count_tags(records):
    counts = {}
    for n in records:
        counts[n["tag"]] = counts.get(n["tag"], 0) + 1
    return counts

result = count_tags(notes)
print("need:", result["need"])
print("goal:", result["goal"])
print("constraint:", result["constraint"])

tests.code: assert count_tags(notes) == {'need': 3, 'goal': 2, 'constraint': 2}, 'expected need 3, goal 2, constraint 2 | got %r' % count_tags(notes)
